justification: Assessment reports INVALID at step 0051, the assertion that 'with 5 colors, there will always be a non-conflicting color available to choose, regardless of which non-conflicting sequence of colors have been chosen prior'. The ground truth flaw is exactly this claim, refuted by a legal execution of the Optimal-Color algorithm on the icosahedron reaching a vertex whose 5 neighbors carry all 5 colors. The assessment's reasoning targets the same defect (unbounded distinct colors on a still-uncolored vertex's neighborhood, degree >= 5 possible in planar graphs) and also notes the same unsupported companion claim at 0045 flagged in the ground truth. It gives no explicit counterexample, but the flawed step matches the ground-truth defect precisely, so this is CAUGHT_MATCHING.
